data.one_liner: Converts dart test JSON output to JUnit XML reports
data.what_it_does: This package reads the JSON or machine output from dart or flutter test runs and produces JUnit‑style XML files. The XML can be consumed by CI tools such as Jenkins.
use_when: You need JUnit XML reports for CI pipelines
You are running dart or flutter tests and want to integrate with tools that consume JUnit format
You prefer a simple command‑line tool over writing custom parsing code
avoid_when: You are not using CI or JUnit reports
You need a Dart API to generate reports programmatically
strengths: Easy to install via dart pub global activate
Supports both dart test JSON and flutter test machine output
Handles control characters and pretty‑prints XML
weaknesses: Only a command‑line tool, no Dart API
Requires global activation which may conflict with path settings
data.setup_notes: Run `dart pub global activate junitreport` and ensure `<dart-cache>/bin` is on your PATH.
